lines.text: باب چهاردهم در بیان حدود و وجوه مثلثات بدانکه هر برجی به پنج قسمت کرده
lines.en: Chapter fourteen: On the explanation of the terms and faces of the triplicities. Know that each sign is divided into five parts,

lines.text: اند و هر قسمی بکوکبی متحیره داده اند چنانکه حمل سی درجه است به پنج قسمت کرده اند
lines.en: and each part is given to a wandering planet, just as Aries is thirty degrees, they have divided it into five parts,

lines.text: شش بمشتری و شش بزهره چنانکه بمانیم هر برجی به سه قسمت کرده اند و انرا وجوه
lines.en: six to Jupiter and six to Venus, as we shall remain. Each sign is divided into three parts, and they call them faces,

lines.text: خوانند چنانکه حمل سی درجه است ده بمریخ داده اند و ده بافتاب و ده بزهره
lines.en: just as Aries is thirty degrees, they have given ten to Mars, ten to the Sun, and ten to Venus.

lines.text: بنماییم فایده مثلثات اینست که طالع را نگاه کنند که روزی است یا شبی
lines.en: We shall show. The benefit of the triplicities is this: they look at the ascendant, whether it is diurnal or nocturnal.

lines.text: اگر روزی باشد خداوند مثلثات روزیرا حکم باشد و اگر شبی باشد مثلثه شبی را حکم باشد
lines.en: If it is diurnal, the lord of the diurnal triplicities has the judgment, and if it is nocturnal, the nocturnal triplicity has the judgment.

summary.headline: Terms and Faces of Triplicities
summary.text: Chapter fourteen explains the planetary terms and faces of the triplicities, including the division of each zodiac sign into five parts and three faces, and the use of diurnal or nocturnal triplicity rulers according to the ascendant. A table lists Aries through Pisces with planetary rulers and numerical values.
